Name: SCIE-Port 移植集合 (Audit Build)
Description: Authorized x25.01.17 port workspace. Creature phase 1 adds manually spawned fox and rabbit using native SCNET four-legged animation and AI; the batch-2 slice adds a manually spawned chicken (Alpaca-derived grazer/herd/flee AI, clean-room six-bone model and palette) that shares the same native AI and becomes a LandOther prey target for the fox. Ecology phase adds a natural spawner that seeds fox and rabbit from the chunk-generation hook, gated by world-seed determinism, an authority check, a per-chunk spawn budget, population ceilings and habitat suitability; it also wires fox-on-rabbit predation purely as a data-level ChaseBehavior override (AutoChaseMask scoped to LandOther, raised non-player chase probability) handled entirely by the native Wolf-derived chase AI. Live entity generation during chunk generation and live predation behaviour are still pending Android/7723 on-device verification. Crop phase adds clean-room corn (seed, staged growth, harvest ear/fodder), bamboo (vertical segment growth, chop harvest, solid building block), flax (staged growth, harvest fiber/seed), sunflower (warm-season staged growth, harvest of edible seeds) and apple (a temperate perennial that grows through stages on the proven crop pattern and, once mature, ripens a pickable edible apple in the autumn fruiting season via a dedicated ripe-fruit DATA bit mirroring the audited WildBerry plant), each backed by a project-generated 512x512 RGBA atlas. Android/7723 verification is required.
